newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: U.S. Amway Corp opens in S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Amway Corp opens in S.Africa.

text.p: U.S. direct selling giant Amway Corp officially opened for business in South Africa on Monday, predicting that its turnover would top 70 million rand within its first year in operation.
General manager Peter Beaumont said he expected about 10,000 South Africans to join its international sales force of more than 2.5 million within a year.

"It is obvious that this idea (direct selling) has great appeal in South Africa because we have been very pleased by the initial response that we have been getting and have had to adjust our initial first-year estimates significantly upwards," he said in a statement.
Amway has opened its head office in Cape Town and a distribution centre in Johannesburg.
Sales people will have to invest an initial 400 rand for a starter pack containing five Amway products and literature on how to run the business and service customers.
The group's range of homecare, health food and cosmetic products will be imported from the U.S. although promotional material and stationery will be sourced locally.
Beaumont earlier this year told Reuters that the South African launch would be the start of Amway's entry into the African market.
Amway has built up a strong presence in South East Asia in recent years and is one of the largest foreign owned companies in Japan. It recently moved into the Philippines.
It is the second U.S. direct mail company to move into South Africa. The first was Avon Products Inc, which last year bought Justine Pty as a conduit for its cosmetics range.
